name: Glutamine
info: The amide of glutamic acid. It transports nitrogen; under some conditions, demand exceeds synthesis.

history.clue: The name is connected with glutamic acid, of which this substance is the amide.
history.story: Glutamine was first isolated from beet juice by Schulze and Bosshard in 1883. The name reflects its relationship to glutamic acid: glutamine is its amide. Through glutamic acid, their shared root goes back to gluten, although glutamine itself was first obtained from beets.
